case_name: Keith Thaete, Steve King, Lance Thaete v. St. Luke's Magic Valley Center, Michael R. Fry, D.O

issues.label: Failure to serve notice of appeal
issues.why: Court must decide whether service, in addition to timely filing, is jurisdictional and whether nonservice requires dismissal.

issues.label: Standard for motion to dismiss appeal
issues.why: Determines whether denial without prejudice was proper and how the jurisdictional defect affects appellate authority.

issues.label: Timeliness of August 28/29 filings
issues.why: Court must assess whether filings six-seven days after the extended August 22 deadline were properly stricken.

issues.label: Rebuttal vs. case-in-chief designation
issues.why: Whether characterizing declarations as rebuttal was improper when opposing a dispositive motion attacking plaintiffs' prima facie case.

issues.label: New standard-of-care opinions and prejudice
issues.why: Whether the late declarations introduced new opinions causing prejudice justifying exclusion.

issues.label: Abuse-of-discretion review of strike order
issues.why: Court must apply the four-part Lunneborg test to the motion to strike ruling.

issues.label: Interplay of amended scheduling deadlines
issues.why: Multiple amendments create ambiguity about which deadlines governed rebuttal disclosures and the response filing.

issues.label: Dr. McIlraith's community standard knowledge
issues.why: Whether he showed actual knowledge of the local standard of care under I.C. 6-1012/6-1013.

issues.label: Shared board certification as foundation
issues.why: Whether common board certification suffices to establish familiarity with the applicable standard of care.

issues.label: Adequacy of Dr. Fry deposition foundation
issues.why: Whether imprecision in Dr. Fry's deposition undermines the expert's foundational basis for opinions.

issues.label: Expert's preparation/inquiry into local standard
issues.why: Whether McIlraith took adequate steps to familiarize himself with the Twin Falls community standard.

issues.label: Nurse Chisum breach opinion existence
issues.why: Whether Chisum's disclosure actually contained a standard-of-care breach opinion for nursing staff.

issues.label: Counsel's contradictory representations re Chisum
issues.why: Whether prior statements that Chisum would not testify preclude relying on her opinions later.

issues.label: Timeliness of Nurse Tripp disclosure
issues.why: Whether Tripp's June supplemental disclosure violated the amended scheduling order deadlines.

issues.label: Admissibility as threshold vs. fact dispute
issues.why: Court must separate expert admissibility from whether admissible testimony creates a genuine factual dispute.

issues.label: Non-application of liberal construction
issues.why: Admissibility determinations do not receive the liberal construction afforded at summary judgment.

issues.label: Prima facie medical malpractice elements
issues.why: Whether plaintiffs can establish standard of care, breach, causation, and damages without admissible experts.

issues.label: Causation link between Paxil and death
issues.why: Whether contraindicated drug administration caused Mrs. Thaete's death must be supported by expert proof.

issues.label: Dr. Fry's knowledge of Nardil prescription
issues.why: Conflicting testimony over whether Dr. Fry saw the bottles bears on breach and creates factual dispute.

issues.label: Hospital vicarious/direct liability
issues.why: Whether St. Luke's liability rests on nursing conduct, policies, or Dr. Fry's actions requires distinct expert support.

issues.label: Adequacy of policy/practice discovery
issues.why: Whether denial/limitation of the internal-policy discovery affected plaintiffs' ability to prove the hospital claim.

issues.label: Reconsideration standard applied
issues.why: Whether the court properly evaluated new arguments and evidence on the motion for reconsideration.

issues.label: Negligence per se/reckless conduct labels
issues.why: Whether pleaded theories survive being treated solely under the Medical Malpractice Act.

issues.label: Summary judgment standard under Rule 56(a)
issues.why: Whether the record shows no genuine dispute of material fact entitling defendants to judgment.

issues.label: Entitlement to attorney fees
issues.why: Court must determine whether either party qualifies for fees on appeal and the governing basis.
